implementation.name: BBC Bridge Companion (MiSTer)
implementation.notes: Source availability (T5.4): open -- the repository carries 26 HDL source files (11 systemverilog, 15 verilog) alongside 4 prebuilt .rbf binaries. There is no open_source column in the delivered schema (data-model.md §1.9 deleted the proposed core table together with its flags); the presence of hdl_language_id and of implementation_path rows is how that fact is stated here. Machine mapping: hand-mapped, not MRA-setname-derived -- a console core ships no MRA files. The core reimplements the BBC Bridge Companion, giving machine_id bbcbc. Every id was checked against extract/machine.json. License: https://github.com/MiSTer-devel/BBCBridgeCompanion_MiSTer/blob/main/LICENSE is the verbatim GNU GPL version 3 text, and the grant in https://github.com/MiSTer-devel/BBCBridgeCompanion_MiSTer/blob/main/BBCBridgeCompanion.sv reads "either version 3 of the License, or (at your option) any later version" -- hence GPL-3.0-or-later. hdl_language_id: no single HDL family reaches 90% of the 26 source files (11 systemverilog, 15 verilog), excluding the shared framework directory. accuracy_id omitted: the repository makes no timing-fidelity claim this build could verify.

implementation_dependency.note: TV80 Z80 core vendored at rtl/tv80/tv80_core.v
